notes.title: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.4 is now available.
notes.content:
Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.4 is now available.
The main updates are as follows

[Bug Fixes]
Fixed a bug in which certain items were not selected for barter in "Barter with Meguru".
The item detail text in the "Item List" in HELP has been partially revised.

notes.title: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.3 is now available.
notes.content:
Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.3 is now available.
The main updates are as follows

[Bug Fixes]
Fixed a bug in which the game could not be played correctly when the language setting of the PC was set to French, etc.

notes.title: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.2 is now available.
notes.content:
Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.2 is now available.
The main updates are as follows

[Bug Fixes]
Fixed a bug in which "Character Episodes" were occurring in an unintended order.
Fixed a bug in which "enhancement parts" items could not be used properly during exploration.
Fixed a bug that frequent items did not drop correctly in some search areas.
Fixed a bug that sound effects were sometimes played over one another.

notes.title: Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.1 is now available.
notes.content:
Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer ver1.0.1 is now available.
The main updates are as follows

[Bug fixes]
Fixed a bug that prevented progress in Episode 4 when the language was set to "Simplified Chinese" or "Traditional Chinese.
